journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics

articles.title_en: Imposing Policy on Reluctant Actors: The Hospital Desegregation Campaign and Black Postneonatal Mortality in the Deep South
articles.title_cn: 对不情愿行为者施加政策：医院去种族隔离运动与深南部黑人产后新生儿死亡率
articles.abstract_en: In 1966, Southern hospitals were barred from participating in Medicare unless they discontinued their longstanding practice of racial segregation. Using data from five Deep South states and exploiting county-level variation in Medicare certification dates, we find that gaining access to an ostensibly integrated hospital had no effect on Black postneonatal mortality. Similarly, there is little evidence that the campaign contributed to the trend toward in-hospital births among Southern Black mothers. These results are consistent with descriptions of the hospital desegregation campaign as producing only cosmetic changes and illustrate the limits of antidiscrimination policies imposed on reluctant actors.
articles.abstract_cn: 在1966，南方医院被禁止参与Medicare，除非它们停止长期存在的种族隔离做法。使用来自五个深南部州的数据，并利用Medicare认证日期在县一级的差异，我们发现获得进入一家表面上整合的医院的机会对黑人产后新生儿死亡率没有影响。同样，几乎没有证据表明该运动促进了南方黑人母亲住院分娩的趋势。这些结果与将医院去种族隔离运动描述为只产生表面变化的说法一致，并说明了对不情愿行为者施加反歧视政策的局限。

articles.title_en: The Summer Drop in Female Employment
articles.abstract_en: We provide the first systematic account of summer declines in women’s labor market activity. From May to July, U.S. women’s employment-to-population ratio declines 1.1 p.p., whereas men’s rises; women’s hours worked fall 9.8%, twice the decline among men. School closures for summer break provide a unifying explanation. The summer drop aligns with cross-state differences in school closure timing, is concentrated among mothers with young school-aged children, and coincides with increased time spent on child care. Gender differences both within and across jobs explain gender gaps in summer exits from employment. Women’s summer work interruptions contribute to gender gaps in pay.

articles.title_en: What Lies Behind the Returns to Schooling: The Role of Labor Market Sorting and Worker Heterogeneity
articles.title_cn: 教育回报背后是什么：劳动力市场排序与工人异质性的作用
articles.abstract_en: Do more educated workers earn higher wages partly because they have access to high-paying firms and occupations? We rely on linked employer-employee data to combine the estimation of AKM (Abowd-Kramarz-Margolis) models with the decomposition of the returns to schooling. We exploit exogenous variation in education driven by changes in compulsory education. We show that education provides access to better-paying workplaces and occupations: 30% of the overall return to education operates through the workplace channel and 12% through the occupation channel. The remainder is associated exclusively with the individual. Match quality plays a modest role in the returns to education.
articles.abstract_cn: 受教育程度更高的工人工资更高，是否部分因为他们能够进入高薪企业和高薪职业？我们利用关联雇主-雇员数据，将AKM（Abowd-Kramarz-Margolis）模型的估计与教育回报的分解相结合。我们利用义务教育变化所驱动的教育外生变动。我们表明，教育提供了进入薪酬更高的工作场所和职业的机会：总体教育回报中30%通过工作场所渠道实现，12%通过职业渠道实现。其余部分则完全与个人相关。匹配质量在教育回报中发挥的作用不大。

articles.title_en: Misperceived Social Norms and Willingness to Act Against Climate Change
articles.title_cn: 被误解的社会规范与应对气候变化的意愿
articles.abstract_en: We document the individual willingness to act against climate change and study the role of social norms in a large sample of U.S. adults. Individual beliefs about social norms positively predict pro-climate donations, comparable in strength to universal moral values and economic preferences. However, we document systematic misperceptions of social norms. Respondents vastly underestimate the prevalence of climate-friendly behaviors and norms. Correcting these misperceptions in an experiment causally raises individual willingness to act against climate change and individual support for climate policies. The effects are strongest for individuals who are skeptical about the existence and threat of global warming.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个美国成年人的大样本中记录了个人应对气候变化的意愿，并研究了社会规范的作用。个人关于社会规范的信念正向预测亲气候捐赠，其强度与普遍道德价值观和经济偏好相当。然而，我们记录了社会规范的系统性误解。受访者极大地低估了气候友好行为和规范的普遍性。在一项实验中纠正这些误解，因果性地提高了个人应对气候变化的意愿和个人对气候政策的支持。对于怀疑全球变暖的存在和威胁的个体，这些效应最强。

articles.title_en: Regulation by Reputation? Intermediaries, Labor Abuses, and International Migration
articles.title_cn: 声誉监管？中介、劳动虐待与国际移民
articles.abstract_en: Migrant workers and employers rely on intermediaries to facilitate labor market placements. If information frictions obscure their reputation, however, intermediaries may underinvest in placement quality. Using data on more than 1.5 million Sri Lankan migrants to the Gulf region, we examine the effects of a government-run intermediary rating program that publicly revealed ratings two years after it was announced. Prior to the ratings’ public release, underperforming intermediaries invest in the rating criteria and place migrants in less abusive and more remunerative employment. Our results suggest the government’s threat of quality revelation induced intermediaries to prospectively screen employers and improve placement quality.
articles.abstract_cn: 移民工人和雇主依赖中介来促进劳动力市场配置。然而，如果信息摩擦使中介的声誉不为人知，中介可能对安置质量投资不足。利用超过1.5百万斯里兰卡移民到海湾地区的数据，我们考察了一项政府运营的中介评级计划的效果，该计划在宣布两年后公开披露评级。在评级公开披露之前，表现不佳的中介会投资于评级标准，并将移民安置到虐待更少且报酬更高的工作中。我们的结果表明，政府威胁披露质量促使中介前瞻性地筛选雇主并提高安置质量。

articles.title_en: No Line Left Behind: Assortative Matching Inside the Firm
articles.title_cn: 不落下一行：企业内部的匹配选择
articles.abstract_en: We leverage the high degree of worker mobility across production lines in a large Indian manufacturer to estimate the sorting of workers to managers, using data on daily worker productivity. We find negative assortative matching (NAM): better workers tend to be matched with worse managers. Estimates of the production technology, however, reveal that productivity would increase by up to 4% under positive sorting. Exploiting a survey of managers and data on orders from multinational brands, we document that NAM arises, at least partly, because maintaining valuable relationships with buyers provides strong incentives to avoid delays on any given production line.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一家大型印度制造商中生产线上工人高度流动的特点，使用工人日生产率数据来估计工人对管理者的分类匹配。我们发现负向匹配（NAM）：更好的工人往往与更差的管理者匹配。然而，对生产技术的估计显示，在正向匹配下，生产率将提高多达4%。利用对管理者的调查和来自跨国品牌的订单数据，我们记录到，NAM的出现至少部分是因为与买家保持有价值的关系提供了强烈激励，以避免任何给定生产线上的延误。

articles.title_en: Social Preferences and Redistributive Politics
articles.title_cn: 社会偏好与再分配政治
articles.abstract_en: We study the link between social preferences and a behaviorally validated measure of support for redistribution. We uncover three fundamentally distinct social preference types: predominantly selfish, inequality averse, and altruistic individuals. Inequality averse and altruistic individuals display a much stronger support for redistribution, particularly if they are more affluent. Beliefs about the role of effort and luck for success play no role for selfish individuals but are highly relevant for other-regarding individuals. Finally, while inequality averse individuals display strong support for policies aimed at reducing the incomes of the rich, altruistic individuals are considerably less supportive of these policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了社会偏好与一种经过行为验证的再分配支持度衡量指标之间的联系。我们发现了三种根本不同的社会偏好类型：以自利为主、不平等厌恶和利他主义个体。不平等厌恶和利他主义个体对再分配表现出强得多的支持，尤其是当他们更为富裕时。关于努力和运气对成功作用的信念对自利个体不起作用，但对顾及他人的个体高度相关。最后，虽然不平等厌恶个体对旨在降低富人收入的政策表现出强烈支持，但利他主义个体对这些政策的支持要低得多。

articles.title_en: Language Barriers in Multinationals and Knowledge Transfers
articles.title_cn: 跨国公司中的语言障碍与知识转移
articles.abstract_en: We study communication frictions within multinationals (MNCs), hypothesizing that language barriers reduce management knowledge transfers within the organization. A distinct feature of such MNCs is a three-tier hierarchy: foreign managers (FMs) supervise domestic managers (DMs) who supervise production workers. Tailored surveys from our setting—MNCs in Myanmar—reveal that language barriers impede interactions between FMs and DMs. A first experimental protocol offers DMs free English courses and confirms that lowering communications costs increases their interactions with FMs. A second experimental protocol that asks human-resource managers at domestic firms to rate hypothetical resumes reveals that multinational experience and, specifically, DM-FM interactions are valued in the domestic labor market. Together, these results suggest that reducing language barriers can improve transfers of management knowledge, an interpretation supported by improvements in soft skills among treatment DMs in the first experiment. A model in which communication within MNCs is noncontractible—a realistic feature of workplace life—reveals that the experimental results are consistent with underinvestment in language training and provide a rationale for policy intervention.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究跨国公司（MNCs）内部的沟通摩擦，假设语言障碍会减少组织内部的管理知识转移。此类跨国公司的一个显著特征是三层等级结构：外国经理（FMs）监督本国经理（DMs），本国经理再监督生产工人。我们在缅甸的跨国公司环境中进行的定制调查显示，语言障碍阻碍了FMs与DMs之间的互动。第一个实验方案向DMs提供免费英语课程，并证实降低沟通成本会增加他们与FMs的互动。第二个实验方案要求本国企业的人力资源经理对假设的简历进行评分，结果显示，跨国公司经历，特别是DM-FM互动，在本国劳动力市场中受到重视。综合来看，这些结果表明，减少语言障碍可以改善管理知识的转移，这一解释得到了第一个实验中处理组DMs软技能提升的支持。一个将跨国公司内部沟通视为不可契约的模型——这是职场生活的一个现实特征——表明实验结果与语言培训投资不足相一致，并为政策干预提供了依据。

articles.title_en: Disentangling the Effects of the 2018–2019 Tariffs on a Globally Connected U.S. Manufacturing Sector
articles.title_cn: 解析2018-2019关税对全球关联的美国制造业部门的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the relationship between the U.S. tariff increases of 2018–2019 and outcomes in domestic manufacturing. Despite being intended to boost manufacturing activity, we find U.S. industries more exposed to tariff increases experience relative reductions in employment, as a small positive effect from import protection is offset by larger negative effects from rising input costs and retaliatory tariffs. Higher tariffs are also associated with relative increases in producer prices due to rising input costs. Last, we document broader labor market impacts, as counties more exposed to rising tariffs exhibit relative increases in unemployment and declines in labor force participation. No rights reserved. This work was authored as part of the Contributor's official duties as an Employee of the United States Government and is therefore a work of the United States Government. In accordance with 17 U.S.C. 105, no copyright protection is available for such works under U.S. Law.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文估计了2018-2019美国关税上调与国内制造业结果之间的关系。尽管旨在提振制造业活动，我们发现受关税上调影响更大的美国行业经历了相对就业减少，因为进口保护带来的小幅正向效应被投入成本上升和报复性关税带来的更大负向效应所抵消。更高的关税还与投入成本上升导致的生产者价格相对上涨相关。最后，我们记录了更广泛的劳动力市场影响，因为受关税上升影响更大的县表现出失业率相对上升和劳动力参与率下降。无权利保留。本作品是作为美国政府雇员作者的官方职责的一部分创作的，因此是美国政府的作品。根据17 U.S.C. 105，此类作品在美国法律下不享有版权保护。

articles.title_en: Immigration and Worker-Firm Matching
articles.title_cn: 移民与工人-企业匹配
articles.abstract_en: Positive assortative matching increases both the wages of more productive workers and wage dispersion. We study the effect of immigration on positive assortative matching using French employer-employee data from 1995 to 2005. We find that increases in the share of immigrants, driven by historical networks across local labor markets, generated stronger positive assortative matching between workers and firms. We present evidence suggesting that this effect was associated with higher wages for more productive workers and that the findings are consistent with increased workers’ screening by firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 正向 assortative matching 同时提高生产率更高工人的工资和工资离散度。我们使用 1995 至 2005 的法国雇主-雇员数据研究移民对正向 assortative matching 的影响。我们发现，由本地劳动力市场历史网络驱动的移民份额增加，在工人与企业之间产生了更强的正向 assortative matching。我们提供的证据表明，这一效应与生产率更高工人工资更高相关，并且这些发现与企业对工人筛选增强相一致。

articles.title_en: Asymptotics of Cointegration Tests for High-Dimensional Var(⁠ 𝑘 ⁠)
articles.title_cn: 高维VAR(⁠𝑘⁠)协整检验的渐近性质
articles.abstract_en: The paper studies nonstationary high-dimensional vector autoregressions of order ⁠ , VAR( ⁠ ⁠ ). Additional deterministic terms such as trend or seasonality are allowed. The number of time periods, ⁠ , and the number of coordinates, ⁠ , are assumed to be large and of the same order. Under this regime the first-order asymptotics of the Johansen likelihood ratio (LR), Pillai-Bartlett, and Hotelling-Lawley tests for cointegration are derived: The test statistics converge to nonrandom integrals. For more refined analysis, the paper proposes and analyzes a modification of the Johansen test. The new test for the absence of cointegration converges to the partial sum of the Airy point process. Supporting Monte Carlo simulations indicate that the same behavior persists universally in many situations beyond those considered in our theorems. The paper presents empirical implementations of the approach for the analysis of S&P100 stocks and of cryptocurrencies. The latter example has a strong presence of multiple cointegrating relationships, while the results for the former are consistent with the null of no cointegration.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究阶数为⁠、VAR(⁠⁠)的非平稳高维向量自回归。允许趋势或季节性等附加确定性项。时间期数⁠和坐标数⁠被假定为很大且同阶。在此机制下，推导了Johansen似然比（LR）、Pillai-Bartlett和Hotelling-Lawley协整检验的一阶渐近性质：检验统计量收敛于非随机积分。为进行更精细的分析，本文提出并分析了一种Johansen检验的修正。新的无协整检验收敛于Airy点过程的部分和。支持性Monte Carlo模拟表明，相同行为在许多超出我们定理所考虑的情形中普遍持续存在。本文给出了该方法在S&P100股票和加密货币分析中的实证应用。后一个例子存在强烈的多重协整关系，而前者的结果与无协整的原假设一致。

articles.title_en: A Fundamental Connection: Exchange Rates and Macroeconomic Expectations
articles.title_cn: 一个根本性联系：汇率与宏观经济预期
articles.abstract_en: We disprove the exchange rate macroeconomic disconnect puzzle by showing that macroeconomic news can explain most variation in exchange rates at monthly and quarterly frequencies, accounting for up to 91% of the quarterly exchange rate variation during U.S. recessions and 65% over all periods. The main driver of the reconnect is exchange rates responding to past news—a result inconsistent with the theory of uncovered interest rate parity under full information rational expectations (UIP-FIRE). We discuss theoretical models that can explain this surprising result, including models featuring currency risk premia, regulatory or institutional frictions, or deviation from FIRE.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们否定了汇率宏观经济脱节之谜，表明宏观经济新闻可以解释月度与季度频率下汇率的大部分变动，在美国衰退期间可解释高达91%的季度汇率变动，在所有时期可解释65%。重新连接的主要驱动因素是汇率对过去新闻的反应——这一结果与完全信息理性预期下的无抛补利率平价理论（UIP-FIRE）不一致。我们讨论了能够解释这一惊人结果的理论模型，包括具有货币风险溢价、监管或制度摩擦，或偏离FIRE特征的模型。

articles.title_en: Coarse Wage Setting and Behavioral Firms
articles.title_cn: 粗放式工资设定与行为型企业
articles.abstract_en: This paper shows that the bunching of wages at round numbers is partly driven by firm coarse wage setting. Using data from more than 200 million new hires in Brazil, I first establish that contracted salaries tend to cluster at round numbers. Then, I show that firms that tend to hire workers at round-numbered salaries have worse market outcomes. Next, I develop a wage-posting model in which optimization costs lead to the adoption of coarse rounded wages and provide evidence supporting two model predictions using two research designs. Finally, I examine some consequences of coarse wage setting for relevant economic outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文表明，工资在整数金额上的聚集部分是由企业的粗放式工资设定驱动的。使用来自巴西超过200百万新雇员的数据，我首先确认合同工资往往聚集在整数金额上。然后，我表明倾向于以整数金额工资雇佣工人的企业市场表现更差。接下来，我构建了一个工资发布模型，其中优化成本导致采用粗略取整的工资，并使用两种研究设计提供了支持两个模型预测的证据。最后，我考察了粗放式工资设定对相关经济结果的一些影响。

articles.title_en: Time Use and Macroeconomic Uncertainty
articles.title_cn: 时间利用与宏观经济不确定性
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of uncertainty on time use and their macroeconomic implications. Employing data from the American Time Use Survey and the Bureau of Labor Statistics, we document that heightened uncertainty increases housework and reduces market hours, mildly impacting leisure. We then propose a model that quantitatively accounts for these estimates. We show that substitution between market and housework provides self-insurance to households, weakening precautionary motives. However, it also reduces aggregate demand, ultimately amplifying uncertainty’s recessionary impact. Time reallocation can lead to higher inflation, particularly when uncertainty is coupled with policies redirecting time use towards housework (e.g., lockdown restrictions).
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究不确定性对时间利用的影响及其宏观经济含义。利用美国时间使用调查和劳工统计局的数据，我们记录到不确定性加剧会增加家务劳动并减少市场工作时间，对闲暇的影响轻微。随后，我们提出一个模型，该模型在数量上解释了这些估计结果。我们表明，市场工作与家务劳动之间的替代为家庭提供了自我保险，削弱了预防性动机。然而，它也减少了总需求，最终放大了不确定性的衰退影响。时间重新配置可能导致更高的通胀，尤其是当不确定性与将时间利用转向家务劳动的政策（例如封锁限制）相结合时。

articles.title_en: The Long-Run Effects of Monetary Policy
articles.title_cn: 货币政策的长期效应
articles.abstract_en: We document that the real effects of monetary shocks last for over a decade. Our approach relies on identification of exogenous and nonsystematic monetary shocks using the trilemma of international finance; merged data from two new international historical cross-country databases; and econometric methods robust to long-horizon inconsistent estimates. Notably, the capital stock and total factor productivity (TFP) exhibit greater hysteresis than labor. When we allow for asymmetry, we find these effects with tightening shocks, but not with loosening shocks. When extending the horizon of the responses reported in several recent studies that use alternative monetary shocks, we find similarly persistent real effects, thus supporting our main findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录到货币冲击的实际效应持续超过十年。我们的方法依赖于利用国际金融三难困境识别外生且非系统性的货币冲击；合并来自两个新的国际历史跨国数据库的数据；以及对长期不一致估计具有稳健性的计量经济学方法。值得注意的是，资本存量和全要素生产率（TFP）表现出比劳动更大的滞后效应。当我们允许不对称性时，我们发现这些效应在紧缩冲击下存在，但在宽松冲击下不存在。当我们将几项近期使用替代货币冲击的研究中报告的响应期限延长时，我们发现同样持久的实际效应，从而支持我们的主要发现。

articles.title_en: The Unobserved Returns to Entrepreneurship
articles.title_cn: 创业的未观测回报
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents an alternative perspective to a long-standing empirical puzzle: that most entrepreneurs persevere despite persistently low earnings. Because entrepreneurial earnings are notoriously difficult to measure, I approach the question from an expenditure angle. I look at how switching into self-employment corresponds to changes in reported earnings versus expenditure. Using 45 years of longitudinal data, I find that individuals report earning 27.7% _less_ in self-employment, while spending 3.8% _more_ . This household expenditure premium accrues with entrepreneurial experience and is not offset by lower savings or longer work hours. The results hold in highly educated and incorporated business owner subsamples.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文对一个长期存在的经验谜题提出了另一种视角：即大多数创业者尽管收入持续偏低却仍坚持创业。由于创业收入以难以衡量著称，我从支出角度切入这一问题。我考察了转入自雇状态如何对应于所报告的收益与支出的变化。利用45年的纵向数据，我发现个人报告在自雇状态下收入27.7%_更少_，而支出3.8%_更多_。这种家庭支出溢价随创业经验而累积，且未被更低的储蓄或更长的工作时间所抵消。该结果在受过高等教育和注册企业主子样本中依然成立。

articles.title_en: Universal Basic Income: Inspecting the Mechanisms
articles.title_cn: 全民基本收入：机制考察
articles.abstract_en: We examine the mechanisms driving the aggregate and distributional impacts of Universal Basic Income (UBI) through model analysis of various UBI programs and financing schemes. The main adverse effect is the distortionary tax increase to fund UBI, reducing labor force participation. Secondary channels are a decline in demand for self-insurance, depressing aggregate capital, and a positive income effect that further deters labor force participation. Due to these channels, introducing UBI alongside existing social programs reduces output and average welfare. Partially substituting existing programs with UBI mitigates the adverse effects, increases average welfare, but does not deliver a Pareto improvement.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过对各种全民基本收入（UBI）方案和融资计划的模型分析，考察驱动全民基本收入（UBI）总体影响和分配影响的机制。主要不利影响是为全民基本收入融资而增税造成的扭曲，降低了劳动力参与率。次要渠道是自我保险需求下降，压低总资本，以及进一步阻碍劳动力参与的正面收入效应。由于这些渠道，在现有社会计划之外引入全民基本收入会降低产出和平均福利。用全民基本收入部分替代现有计划可减轻不利影响，提高平均福利，但不会带来帕累托改进。

articles.title_en: When Nurses Travel: Labor Supply Responses to Peak Demand for Nurses
articles.title_cn: 当护士出行：护士峰值需求的劳动供给反应
articles.abstract_en: We study how a market uses temporary workers to accommodate extraordinary demand shocks. When COVID-19 surges, hospitals need additional nurses—especially in specialties central to COVID-19 care. By comparing markets for COVID-relevant and other specialties, we show that the market for travel nurses expands dramatically, and we estimate travel nurse labor supply across space. Supply is quite elastic, as workers can choose to travel where they are needed. Workers travel longer distances to temporary jobs when payment increases, suggesting that an integrated national market facilitates reallocation when demand spikes. But when national cases peak, travel distance is less responsive to local demand.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究市场如何利用临时工来应对异常的需求冲击。当COVID-19激增时，医院需要额外的护士——尤其是在COVID-19护理核心的专业领域。通过比较COVID相关专业与其他专业的市场，我们表明旅行护士市场急剧扩张，并估计了旅行护士在空间上的劳动供给。供给相当富有弹性，因为工人可以选择前往需要他们的地方。当报酬增加时，工人会为临时工作走更远的距离，这表明一个一体化的全国市场在需求激增时促进了重新配置。但当全国病例达到峰值时，旅行距离对当地需求的反应减弱。

articles.title_en: Estimating Nursing Home Quality with Selection
articles.title_cn: 估计存在选择时的养老院质量
articles.abstract_en: We use variational inference (VI), a technique from the machine learning literature, to estimate a mortality-based Bayesian model of nursing home quality accounting for selection. We demonstrate how one can use VI to quickly and flexibly estimate a high-dimensional economic model with large datasets. Using our facility quality estimates, we examine the correlates of quality and find that public report cards have near-zero correlation. We then show that in contrast to prior literature, higher-quality nursing homes fared better during the pandemic: a one standard deviation increase in quality corresponds to 2.5% fewer COVID-19 cases.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用变分推断（VI），一种来自机器学习文献的技术，来估计一个基于死亡率的贝叶斯养老院质量模型，并考虑选择问题。我们展示了如何使用VI快速灵活地估计具有大型数据集的高维经济模型。利用我们的设施质量估计，我们考察了质量的相关因素，发现公共报告卡的相关性几乎为零。然后我们表明，与先前文献相反，高质量的养老院在疫情期间表现更好：质量提高一个标准差对应于2.5%更少的COVID-19病例。

articles.title_en: Raising State Minimum Wages, Lowering Community College Enrollment
articles.title_cn: 提高州最低工资，降低社区大学入学率
articles.abstract_en: Changes in the minimum wage may impact college enrollment and educational attainment. Using institutional data on college enrollment and program completion, we find that enrollment falls markedly among students at public two-year institutions in response to increases in the minimum wage. The largest enrollment effects are seen for those students who are enrolled part-time at community colleges. We find little evidence of negative effects on the attainment of certificates or degrees, suggesting that increases in the minimum wage are unlikely to divert students from degree attainment.
articles.abstract_cn: 最低工资的变化可能影响大学入学率和教育程度。利用关于大学入学率和项目完成情况的机构数据，我们发现，面对最低工资的提高，公立两年制院校的学生入学率显著下降。入学率效应最大的是那些在社区大学非全日制入学的学生。我们几乎没有发现对证书或学位获得产生负面影响的证据，这表明最低工资的提高不太可能使学生偏离学位获得。

articles.title_en: Misspecified Exponential Regressions: Estimation, Interpretation, and Average Marginal Effects
articles.title_cn: 误设的指数回归：估计、解释与平均边际效应
articles.abstract_en: Exponential regressions are frequently used when outcomes are non-negative. They are attractive because they are easy to interpret and to estimate, using pseudomaximum likelihood (PML). However, the validity of these methods depends on the correct specification of the conditional expectation, and little is known regarding their properties when the conditional expectation is misspecified. We show that PML estimators of misspecified exponential models provide optimal approximations to the conditional expectation, in a weighted mean squared error sense, and we give conditions under which their Poisson PML estimator identifies average marginal effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 当结果变量非负时，指数回归常被使用。它们之所以有吸引力，是因为易于解释和估计，可采用伪极大似然（PML）。然而，这些方法的有效性取决于条件期望的正确设定，而当条件期望被误设时，关于其性质所知甚少。我们表明，误设指数模型的PML估计量在加权均方误差意义下提供了对条件期望的最优近似，并给出了其泊松PML估计量识别平均边际效应的条件。

articles.title_en: A Comment on “Raising Health Awareness in Rural Communities: A Randomized Experiment in Bangladesh and India” by Siddique et al. (2024)
articles.title_cn: 对Siddique等人（2024）《提高农村社区的健康意识：在孟加拉国和印度的一项随机实验》的评论
articles.abstract_en: Siddique et al. ( 2024 ) report large effects of a mobile phone-based health awareness campaign in a field experiment conducted in rural Bangladesh and India during the COVID-19 pandemic. Treatments are stated as being randomized at the village level in the Bangladesh arm, but analyses of available replication materials from this and related field experiments show that this was not the case: participants retained their treatment group assignment from two earlier studies run by the same NGO. Because these earlier studies reported large and persistent treatment effects, the treatment groups in Siddique et al. ( 2024 ) could plausibly differ systematically, raising issues of confounding and interaction effects that invalidate the analyses and interpretations of this study, affecting both internal and external validity.
articles.abstract_cn: Siddique等人（2024）报告了在COVID-19疫情期间于孟加拉国和印度农村进行的一项实地实验中，基于手机的健康意识宣传活动产生了巨大效果。文中称在孟加拉国分支中处理是在村庄层面随机化的，但对来自该实验及相关实地实验的可用复制材料的分析表明，情况并非如此：参与者保留了由同一非政府组织运行的两项早期研究中的处理组分配。由于这些早期研究报告了巨大且持续的处理效应，Siddique等人（2024）中的处理组可能存在系统性差异，引发了混杂和交互效应的问题，使本研究的分析和解释无效，影响了内部效度和外部效度。

articles.title_en: Response to the Comment on “Raising Health Awareness in Rural Communities: A Randomized Experiment in Bangladesh and India” (Siddique et al., 2024)
articles.title_cn: 对《提高孟加拉国与印度农村社区健康认知的随机试验》评论的回应（Siddique 等，2024）
